answer: An identity becomes a person only after three agents it cannot control confirm it, each drawn from a rotating pool that refreshes every ridge of 12 epochs, and any single objection sends the claim back to the queue. Cedar stakes back each confirmation and a wrong signature burns them. The break point is rotation speed: a slow pool lets one operator corner a third of the auditors, and pigment-rich farms then confirm each other. Rotate every 12 epochs and cornering costs more than an epoch of payouts.
